skipped_days.reason: no usable DA day in the history file

station: Simulated Torus-style station on Clearlane: wear W, host ceiling, export limit, System Critical Hours by the price proxy (jam hours plus the 4 highest-price hours; the history has no net load), Spin full. No RMP calls are replayed.

settlement.rule: DA price x DA schedule + RT price x (actual - DA schedule), per 15-minute interval
settlement.note: EDAM settlement structure UNVERIFIED against CAISO's EDAM business practice manual. A behind-the-meter station is not itself a market participant, so these are values to RMP's system at CAISO prices, not Torus revenue.

policies.hold: Hold the day-ahead plan all day.
policies.replan: Re-plan at the top of every hour from the actual state of charge over the rest of the day. Forecast: day-ahead prices, with the last observed hour's mean RT minus DA gap carried over the next hour (ASSUMPTION).
policies.foresight: Perfect foresight: the plan solved on the day's real-time prices. Not achievable; it is the yardstick for regret.

regret: Regret is the foresight value minus the policy's value, net of wear at W: the objective all three plans maximize, so it is never below zero. replan_recovers_pct is the share of hold's summed regret that hourly re-planning wins back; it is negative when re-planning does worse than holding.

measured.note: Re-plan times are timed with performance.now() around each hourly re-solve and printed by engine/cli/replay.ts (median, p90, max). They are never written to this file.
